what: Regeneration of the offline unified buffers after the action-taxonomy fix (WP6.3 step 1).
why: build_unified_buffer.py / build_unified_buffer_v2.py action_of() emitted action-type integers under a taxonomy (0=none,1=alert,2=reroute,3=expedite,4=inventory,5=backup,6=cancel) that did NOT match rl.gym_env.ACTION_TYPES (0=do_nothing,1=activate_backup_supplier,2=reroute_shipment,3=increase_safety_stock,4=expedite_order,5=hedge_commodity,6=issue_supplier_alert). The Jul-2 fix remapped each branch to the correct env-canonical integer; the pre-fix real_unified*.npz on disk (dated Apr 26) still encoded the wrong labels and was rebuilt here.
note: Branch CONDITIONS are unchanged, so per-branch counts are preserved; only the emitted integer permutes to match the env. Rewards are unchanged (they do not depend on the action label).
downstream_impact: Offline agents trained on the OLD real_train_v2.npz (bc_v2/cql_v2/iql_v2/td3bc_v2) learned scrambled action semantics and are marked retrain_pending_on_regenerated_buffer in the leaderboard (retrain = WP7.3). The *_best.pt offline checkpoints (bc_best/cql_best/iql_best/td3bc_best) were trained on offline_buffer.npz, which is built by rolling the ENV with the scripted+random agents (env-canonical actions) and is therefore unaffected by this bug.
